title: A Proof of Bala's Congruence Conjecture for A028342
summary: Let $a(n)$ be the sequence A028342 in the On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences (OEIS), defined by the exponential generating function $\sum_{n\ge0} a(n)x^n/n! = \prod_{i\ge1}(1-x^i)^{-1/i}$. Equivalently, $a(n)$ counts permutations of an $n$-element labeled set in which every cycle is assigned one divisor of its length, where a cycle of length $m$ has $d(m)$ choices, $d(m)$ being the number of positive divisors of $m$.
